title: All shortcuts: picks Dev for speed, agrees to daily updates, agrees to private thanks
goal: Take Amara's easy way out in every beat and never push back: pick Dev because he is quickest, agree to daily updates and reviewing every draft, and agree the private thank-you is enough.
must_hit: Picks Dev without asking about workload
Agrees to daily updates and every-draft review
Agrees to a quick private thank-you, no specifics

intents.when: Amara explains the request and asks what you think
intents.do: Agree with Amara: give it to Dev, he's the quickest.
examples: Sounds right, give it to Dev. He's the quickest.

intents.when: Amara pushes or asks you to confirm
Amara proposes daily updates and every-draft review
examples: Yes, daily updates and checking each draft sounds safe. Do that.

intents.when: Amara plans a quick private thank-you message
examples: That's fine, a quick message is plenty.
